messages:
Aisha (AE): heads-up — customer POC hitting parser errors on our tool/function call flow, says parser throws 'Extra data after JSON' on the response. They need a workaround asap (POC blocked).

Ravi (SE): which model + SDK? sample raw response pls. also any 429s in your ingress logs?

Aisha (AE): using redwood hosted api, model rdx-large-2026, SDK 0.9.2. Streaming enabled. here's the raw assistant stream chunk we captured: 

```
{"type":"assistant","content":{"json": "{\\\"action\\\":\\\"create_order\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"id\\\":123}}"}}\n)}\ngarbage: eof
```

Ravi (SE): ugh that's the classic trailing chunk garbage — looks like the model stream ended with an extra suffix. two quick asks: (1) do you call response.json() or parse raw text? (2) can you repro with streaming=false?

Aisha (AE): customer uses our client side parser (JSON.parse on assembled chunks). Repro: yes when streaming=true. They tried streaming=false and it worked but latency spikes. Customer wants streaming for UX.

Marta (eng): probable cause: we occasionally emit a final delim or progress token after JSON when using continuous generation + tool routing. Short-term workaround: sanitize the assembled stream before JSON.parse, e.g. trim after last closing brace: 

```js
const s = assembledChunks;
const idx = s.lastIndexOf('}');
const sanitized = s.slice(0, idx+1);
JSON.parse(sanitized);
```

Marta (eng): Long-term fix: I'll add a sanitizer in the SDK that strips trailing non-json after final object when json_mode=STRICT and streaming=true. Will open PR and a patch release today.

Ken (infra): also saw rate-limiter hits in front of the tool router for that customer — their test harness spikes to 160 rps which triggers 429s on burst window (burst_threshold=120). snippet from ingress: 

```
[2026-11-03T16:12:03Z] customer=acme-corp route=/generate status=429 qps=160 burst=160 limit=120
```

Ken (infra): 429 can interrupt stream assembly and leave partial payloads. Recommend reducing send rate or request temporary burst increase for the POC. I can grant a +50 burst for 48h if sales wants.

Aisha (AE): can we do both: SDK patch + temporary burst increase? customer agreed to try sanitized client while we patch. also need a billing note if we bump burst.

Ravi (SE): yes. immediate steps: (1) Ken grant +50 burst (48h) — pls confirm; (2) Marta publish SDK patch v0.9.3 with streaming json sanitization; (3) Aisha ask customer to enable client-side sanitize as interim. I'll prepare a short troubleshooting doc for them.

Ken (infra): granted temporary burst. updated quota for acme-corp: burst=170 for 48h.

Marta (eng): opened PR #412 — adding sanitizeStreamingJson option default true for json_mode=STRICT. ETA patch release in ~4 hours. I'll post link once CI passes. :rocket:

Aisha (AE): awesome, please ping me when PR is merged. I'll relay to customer and keep them unblocked. thanks team :thumbsup:

SE-bot: ticket RED-4287 created (POC - json parse failures). assigning to Marta, Ken, Ravi. link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/RED-4287
